test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five friends V, W, X, Y, and Z are eating dinner around a circular dining table, facing the centre. X is an immediate neighbour of both Z and W. V is sitting to the immediate left of W. Y is sitting second to the left of W. Who is sitting to the immediate left of X?
solution:
As per the information given in the question, Five friends V, W, X, Y, and Z are sitting around the circular table facing centre as below:

Step 1: V is sitting to the immediate left of W. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df0bf7560ac661e983a78a3b19020b1f7ffaaddffd263a13bb7073f46a7f98ac.png] 

Step 2: X is an immediate neighbour of both Z and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be8c4f2f5d419c20204f9ae8903aaa3047224371d7c09f75aac7115fabb70162.png] 

Step 3: Y is sitting second to the left of W

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f71b7e7a7599637807c8dd2f7a39a959f296f2e4f1433bcf94f6ac0b12fe677.png] 

In the above arrangement, **W sits to the immediate left of X.**

Hence, the correct answer** **is '**W'.**
